boundary.boundary_difference: Go NewDecoderFromIVF copies packet payloads during its timed constructor; C wraps preloaded packet slices without copying them. C still parses IVF frame records in the timed interval. This is a public-API comparison, not an isolated language/SIMD comparison.
boundary.corpus_provenance: not provided to this helper; do not infer source provenance
boundary.dav1d_timed_operation: parse IVF frame records from preloaded whole-file bytes + fresh single-thread dav1d context + wrap packet slices without copying + decode/drain/observe visible frame edges + unref pictures + close context
boundary.excluded_from_both: file reads, input SHA-256, sidecar reads, full-output MD5 preflight and result comparison; process startup
boundary.go_diagnostics: cold NewDecoder(payloads) excludes IVF parsing and packet copying; warm Reset+DecodeNext reuses one decoder. Both are reported but excluded from the primary ratio.
boundary.go_timed_operation: NewDecoderFromIVF(preloaded IVF bytes) + all DecodeNext calls + touch first/last visible byte of Y/U/V and dimensions + Close; timed constructor parses IVF and copies packet payloads
